message: .github/dependabot.yml has no updates entry with package-ecosystem: npm for api, which projects in depcurfew.json lists, so Dependabot does not update the npm dependencies of api, while it updates web
fix: If Dependabot should update api, add an updates entry with package-ecosystem: npm and directory: /api to .github/dependabot.yml, then run depcurfew apply to give it the cooldown
